improvement.change: Five stalls receive board-built counters with rounded nosings, short scalloped woven canvas valances, thin folded eave flashing and visible join fasteners.
improvement.route_note: No floor obstacles added; canvas bottom stays above2.8m and signs remain exposed.

visual_review.observed_improvement: Short scalloped fabric valances read as thin textile beneath the signs; counters show separate boards and rolled nosing instead of a single rectangular slab. The central route remains visibly open.
visual_review.remaining_weakness: The broad route still reads uniformly smooth and the rear tree line is sparse; later ground/perimeter cycles address those. Cars retain simplistic silhouettes in the far arena.
visual_review.next_cycle: Replace bumper-car body and seat silhouettes while preserving each individual eligible actor.
